atoms.text: Charlie lebt in Kanada und teilt seine Erfahrungen auf seinem Social Media Profil.
Tippe auf den ersten Beitrag oben links, um ihn dir genauer anzusehen.
atoms.sound: ssml: <break time='300ms'/>I am Charlie and here you will find life facts and adventures from Canada! Are you ready for some maple leaf tales? <break time='1000ms'/> <voice voiceLang='de' voice='f5'>Tippe auf den ersten Beitrag oben links, um ihn dir genauer anzusehen.</voice>

ssml: <break time='300ms'/>With an area of 9.9 million square kilometres, Canada is the second largest country on earth. In total, Canada has about 38 million inhabitants and its capital city is Ottawa.
ssml: <break time='300ms'/>Did you know that our flag is called Maple leaf flag?

atoms.text: Tippe auf das Foto, auf dem ein Straßenschild zu erkennen ist.
atoms.sound: ssml: <voice voiceLang='de' voice='f5'>Tippe auf das Foto, auf dem ein Straßenschild zu erkennen ist.</voice>

ssml: <break time='300ms'/>Canada was shaped by British and French colonialism. This is why we have two official languages: French and English. Street signs are mainly in both languages. <break time='300ms'/>I learned them in school, so I speak both.

atoms.text: Tippe auf das Foto mit der Skyline, um mehr über das Stadtleben in Kanada zu erfahren.
atoms.sound: ssml: <voice voiceLang='de' voice='f5'>Tippe auf das Foto mit der Skyline, um mehr über das Stadtleben in Kanada zu erfahren.</voice>

ssml: <break time='300ms'/>I live with my parents in Canada's biggest city: Toronto! More than half of its citizens were born elsewhere, and I'm proud to live in such a diverse city. <break time='500ms'/> <voice voiceLang='de' voice='f5'>Es sieht so aus, als hätte Charlie einige ungelesene Nachrichten. Tippe auf die Sprechblase.</voice>
atoms.text: Es sieht so aus, als hätte Charlie einige ungelesene Nachrichten. Tippe auf die Sprechblase.

instruction.text: Hilf Charlie, die Fragen zu beantworten.

atoms.b: Canada is so beautiful! I live in India, the second largest country in the world by population. How many inhabitants does Canada have?
Canada is home to ((++38_million 3800)) people. But it is the second ((++largest smallest)) country in the world by area!

instruction.text: Hilf Charlie, die Fragen zu beantworten.

atoms.b: Hey Charlie, I love your posts! Do you live in the capital city of Canada?
Hey Milou! No, I don't. I live in ((++Toronto Vancouver)) which is Canada's ((++biggest smallest)) city. But Canada's capital city is ((++Ottawa Winnipeg)).

atoms.text: Klicke auf den Beitrag, auf dem Berge und ein See zu erkennen sind.
atoms.sound: ssml: <voice voiceLang='de' voice='f5'>Klicke auf den Beitrag, auf dem Berge und ein See zu erkennen sind.</voice>
ssml: <break time='300ms'/>Canada has fifty national parks and breathtaking nature and wildlife.
ssml: moose <break time='600ms'/>and SO many more animals!<break time='600ms'/>
ssml: My family and I go camping every year, so I know the rules to avoid grizzlies: make noise and don't ever leave food out in the open!

atoms.text: Welcher Beitrag verrät etwas über Sport in Kanada? Tippe auf das entsprechende Bild.
atoms.sound: ssml: <voice voiceLang='de' voice='f5'>Welcher Beitrag verrät etwas über Sport in Kanada? Tippe auf das entsprechende Bild.</voice>

ssml: <break time='300ms'/>Canada is a country of sports, but ice hockey is the most popular and very successful in international comparison. My sister and I are big fans of the Toronto Maple Leafs, but I also play hockey myself in our school team.

atoms.text: Tippe auf das Bild mit dem Totempfahl, um mehr über Kanadas Ureinwohner zu erfahren.
atoms.sound: ssml: <voice voiceLang='de' voice='f5'>Tippe auf das Bild mit dem Totempfahl, um mehr über Kanadas Ureinwohner zu erfahren.</voice>

ssml: <break time='300ms'/>Canada's indigenous peoples, also known as First Nations, Inuit and Métis, have a history dating back thousands of years. They have contributed significantly to Canada's cultural diversity and have a deep connection with nature. For some, totem poles are an important expression of identity. <break time='600ms'/><voice voiceLang='de' voice='f5'>Es sieht so aus, als hätte Charlie einige neue ungelesene Nachrichten. Tippe auf die Sprechblase.</voice>
atoms.text: Es sieht so aus, als hätte Charlie ein paar neue ungelesene Nachrichten. Tippe auf die Sprechblase.

instruction.text: Hilf Charlie die Fragen zu beantworten.

atoms.b: Hi Charlie! I'd love to go camping one day in Canada. Do you have some tips?
atoms.sound: ssml: <prosody rate = '20%'>Hi Charlie! I'd love to go camping one day in Canada. Do you have some tips?</prosody>

atoms.b: Hey Zula! You should watch out for ((++grizzly_bears orca_whales)). Avoid leaving ((++food clothing)) lying around and make ((++noise dinner)) to keep them away.

instruction.text: Hilf Charlie, die Fragen zu beantworten.

atoms.b: I think it's great that you talk about indigenous peoples. What are the names of Canada's indigenous peoples again?
Hey Eli, I'm glad you're interested! Canada has a lot of indigenous people, including the ((++First_Nations Maori)), ((++Inuit vikings)) and Métis. They have a deep connection to ((++nature space)).
